home.name: Logan Thompson
home.news: Thompson has quietly become one of the NHL's most consistent and reliable goalies over the past several seasons, coming off consecutive 31-win campaigns. The 29-year-old goalie hopes to continue his upward trajectory after an encouraging start to the season, saving 31 of 33 shots (.939 SV%) in his only game so far, a 5-2 win over the Carolina Hurricanes. The Capitals enter Wednesday as -154 home favourites against a Pittsburgh Penguins team that has outscored its opposition 15-8 through three games (2-1-0).

away.name: Devon Levi
away.news: Levi has been far from spectacular, but he has won both of his outings and will return to the crease for a third straight game on Wednesday against the Anaheim Ducks. The 24-year-old goalie has a chance to earn significant playing time in Edmonton, but he certainly hopes to improve his 4.02 GAA and .810 SV% over his two games this season (2-0-0).
